## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ebe3742cf5b809d41c575437f07d7d8980231c95`

Read: card objectui#10841 (body, triage `5859992657`, claim `5860203663`, dev report `5860416320`), PR #10855 body, diff and check-runs, the branch at `refs/review/pr-10855` and `origin/main` at `4aebea00a`. The dev report was treated as a claim; every reading below was re-taken in a throwaway worktree of the head (deps installed offline, the pin and a probe run through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry).

### ① Derived judgments

**The forwarded set: right on its face, wrong in its provenance.** `rootDomProps` keeps `id`, `style`, `role`, `data-*`, `aria-*`. Measured per variant at the head (flat `OL`, grouped `DIV`, horizontal `DIV`, gantt `DIV`): the root carries `class`, `id`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid`, and on the vertical case `role`, `style`, `aria-label`; no `items`, `variant`, `dateformat`, `scale`, `rowlabel`, `mindate`, `maxdate`; React DOM-prop warnings 0. With the spread restored the same probe shows `items="[object Object]"` and the rest, so the PR table is accurate.

- `role` beyond the triage list is right: `resolveAriaProps` in `SchemaRenderer` emits `role` beside `aria-label` / `aria-describedby`, and `role` is a member of the repo's own `SDUI_DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS` (`packages/core/src/utils/dom-props.ts`), whose docblock says withholding it is the declared-but-not-delivered failure.
- `data-*` / `aria-*` by prefix: an author can write `data-foo` or `aria-hidden` on a node (`BaseSchema` is passthrough) and it lands. That is the contract's stated position ("open in HTML, open in the widget contract"), and it is what carries `data-obj-*`, `data-testid`, `data-debug-*`. Correct.
- `style`: an authored `BaseSchema.style` object landed before and lands now. The converged renderers (`container.tsx`, `header-bar.tsx`, pinned by `header-bar-root-dom-props-10496.test.tsx`) forward `style` by name too, so keeping it is consistent. Not a change.

**DEFECT A: a third DOM allowlist, diverging from the ruled executor.** `@object-ui/core` already exports `toDomProps` / `pickDomProps` / `SDUI_DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS`; its docblock states the objectui#4425 phase-2 ruling ("`toDomProps`' whitelist is promoted to the SDUI widget contract", "One MECHANISM, two DECLARATIONS ... not two judges", "Everything else should call `toDomProps`"), and `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` records the migration as per-package cards consuming that one executor. `plugin-timeline` already imports `ComponentRegistry` from `@object-ui/core`. This PR mints a module-private `ROOT_DOM_ATTRIBUTES` / `rootDomProps` instead, and it does not match the contract: it drops `tabIndex`, `autoFocus`, `onClick`, `onBlur`, `onFocus`, which `toDomProps` forwards. Measured on the same probe: a node with `tabIndex: 0` renders `tabindex="0"` on the base and on the converged route (`toDomProps(hostProps)` plus `style` by name, the `container.tsx` / `header-bar.tsx` shape), and nothing at this head. None of the five is named in the PR's "Dropped" paragraph, which says only that no in-repo caller passes an event handler or a `ref`; triage note 1 asked that no dropped prop go unsaid. The converged route passes the new pin unchanged (6 passed with the probe alongside), so this is a substitution, not a redesign. AGENTS.md #0.1 / #5: one contract, no parallel dialect.

**Dropped, verified.** `disabled` (the evaluated verdict `SchemaRenderer` forwards as `disabled: __disabled || undefined`): no `[disabled]` or `:disabled` selector in `packages/plugin-timeline`, the `Timeline*` primitives, or any stylesheet targets an `ol` / `div` rail (the tree's `[disabled]` hits are `button` / form controls and Radix `data-[disabled]`); `disabled` is not an ARIA attribute, so the accessibility tree of an `ol` is unchanged; no test in the tree asserts it on a timeline root (`plugin-timeline:timeline` appears in six files, none rendering it disabled). Dropping it is what `dom-props.ts` prescribes ("a semantic prop is CONSUMED, never forwarded"). `title` / `name` / `label`: no in-repo author writes them on a `plugin-timeline:timeline` node. Note `title` is a global HTML attribute with a native-tooltip effect, so the dev report's "neither has an effect" is loose for it; the changeset attaches "no effect" to `disabled` only, which is right.

**Caller survey, re-taken.** (a) `plugin-timeline:timeline` via `SchemaRenderer`'s `createElement`: the bag is every non-metadata node key, the legacy `props` bag, `resolveAriaProps` output, `disabled` verdict, `data-obj-*`, conditional `data-testid`, dev `data-obj-schema-invalid`, debug `data-debug-*`, host props. (b) `ObjectTimeline`: `TimelineRenderer schema={effectiveSchema}` and nothing else; `ObjectTimelineRenderer` spreads its props onto `ObjectTimeline`, which does not forward them. (c) `git grep TimelineRenderer` over `packages`, `apps`, `examples` on `origin/main`: no importer outside `packages/plugin-timeline`; inside it, tests only, each passing `schema` alone. Matches the PR.

**Schema faces.** `TimelineRenderer`'s prop type, `TimelineSchema` (TS and zod) and the registration metadata are untouched; nothing newly accepted or refused. `Clause-②: no` is honest by the claim's own test.

**Pins, verified.** `timeline-root-dom-props-10841.test.tsx` renders one authored node per variant plus the bare-route control through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the package entry's registrations. Head: 5 passed. Spread restored (`{...rootProps}` to `{...props}`, 4 sites): 4 failed, 1 passed, first failure `root carries items="[object Object]"`. Bag dropped: 4 failed on `the authored testId no longer reaches the root`, so the `data-testid` control has teeth. Each variant asserts `items` and `variant` absent by name, as triage note 2 asked.

### ② Semver level

`patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-timeline` is the right level: a rendering defect closed, no authoring face moved, the package is in the fixed group. **DEFECT B, changeset text:** "an undeclared `title` / `name` / `label` on the node" is false for two of the three. `BaseSchema` declares `name?: string` ("Human-readable name for the component") and `label?: string | I18nLabel`; `TimelineSchema extends BaseSchema` and tombstones neither. Only `title` is undeclared. The same sentence is in the PR body and the `ROOT_DOM_ATTRIBUTES` docblock. Also loose: "that bag holds every authored key of the node" (the PR body itself lists the metadata keys `SchemaRenderer` strips first). Every other sentence checks out against the probe: the attribute names, the per-camelCase-key warnings, the kept set, the `ObjectTimeline` route.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Deviation 1, `role` kept: justified by the contract (`SDUI_DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS` contains `role`).
- Deviation 2, `disabled` / `title` / `name` / `label` dropped: per contract and unobserved by any reader; the "undeclared" wording is Defect B.
- Unsaid drops (Defect A): `tabIndex`, `autoFocus`, `onClick`, `onBlur`, `onFocus`, the contract's own pass-through keys.
- Out of scope, confirmed and unchanged: the bare `view:timeline` route carries no `data-obj-*` / `data-testid` (`ObjectTimeline` hands `schema` alone); the gantt refusal `role="alert"` divs never received the root props. Also: `plugin-timeline:` is not in the leak sweep's `OWNED_NAMESPACES`, so the ratchet gate still does not cover this target and the per-variant pin is the only guard.
- PR body: false on "undeclared `name` / `label`" (Defect B); otherwise its measurements reproduce.
- Pending changesets naming `renderer.tsx`: no `changeset-claim-re-read` bot comment exists and the check passed; `6353-timeline-bare-key-ownership.md` (registration keys), `6170-*` (keys read off `schema`), `6356-timeline-item-element.md` (the `schema` prop type) make claims this diff does not touch. None made false.
- CI on the head, read from the check-runs after they settled: 43 check-runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (dependabot and the two coverage matrices), 0 failed. Green CI does not reach Defect A: no gate in the tree compares a plugin's DOM allowlist with `SDUI_DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS`, and the leak sweep does not discover `plugin-timeline:`.

**Fix for Defect A:** replace `rootDomProps` with the converged route, `const { style, ...hostProps } = props` and `{...toDomProps(hostProps)} style={style}` at the four roots, delete `ROOT_DOM_ATTRIBUTES` / `rootDomProps`, and let the docblock point at `dom-props.ts` for the set. **Fix for Defect B:** in the changeset, PR body and docblock, say `name` / `label` are declared `BaseSchema` members with no effect on an `ol` / `div`, and `title` is the undeclared one.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-10841-timeline-root-props`
Reviewed-by: `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`

**VERDICT: FAIL**
